g.text: 1. VFD: Noritake CU20029ECPB-W1J (2x20). JP2 OPEN = M68 (HD44780) mode, 8-bit bus. JP3 open: pin 3 = NC.

g.desc: 1. VFD: Noritake CU20029ECPB-W1J (2x20). JP2 OPEN = M68 (HD44780) mode, 8-bit bus. JP3 open: pin 3 = NC.

g.text: 2. VFD draws 400 mA typ., up to ~800 mA inrush - power it from a separate 5 V supply, NOT from the Arduino 5V pin.

g.desc: 2. VFD draws 400 mA typ., up to ~800 mA inrush - power it from a separate 5 V supply, NOT from the Arduino 5V pin.

g.text: Arduino UNO: do not connect +5V_VFD to the UNO 5V pin while USB is plugged in. Only GND is common.

g.desc: Arduino UNO: do not connect +5V_VFD to the UNO 5V pin while USB is plugged in. Only GND is common.

g.text: 3. C1/C2 and C3/C4 sit right at each display connector (pins 1-2).

g.desc: 3. C1/C2 and C3/C4 sit right at each display connector (pins 1-2).

g.text: 4. Both displays share RS, R/W, DB0-DB7; each has its own E (D11 = left, D6 = right).

g.desc: 4. Both displays share RS, R/W, DB0-DB7; each has its own E (D11 = left, D6 = right).

g.text: 5. Keep the bus wires short (< 20 cm), especially E.

g.desc: 5. Keep the bus wires short (< 20 cm), especially E.
